Population increased in Tyne and Wear (county)

The estimated population of Tyne and Wear (county) in 2024 was 1,178,389 usual residents, a rise of 1.5% since 2023.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Tyne and Wear (county) increased by 4.6%.

Age profile of Tyne and Wear (county)

The average (median) age fell to 39.9 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Tyne and Wear (county) has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
By age category, Tyne and Wear (county)'s population of 1,178,389 usual residents was made up of:

  • 204,424 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.3%)
  • 747,334 people aged 16 to 64 years, (63.4%)
  • 226,631 people aged 65 years and over, (19.2%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Tyne and Wear (county) has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 0 to 15 years (17.3% compared with 18.3% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Tyne and Wear (county), the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Tyne and Wear (county)
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Tyne and Wear (county), between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 1,748 people (-0.2%). In total, there were 10,619 births and 12,367 deaths in Tyne and Wear (county).
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 614 (0.1%). There were 43,034 people entering the area and 42,420 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Tyne and Wear (county)'s population of 18,975 (1.6%) as a result of 25,268 people entering the area and 6,293 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Tyne and Wear (county) was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Tyne and Wear (county) in mid-2023 is 1,160,554.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 5,218 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 2,124 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 7,342 people.
